title: z-image requests keep their intended dimensions
summary:
Image dimensions and API errors got less surprising, while old donation paths were cleared out.

Updated z-image’s resolution math for 2× SPAN upscaling. Requests can specify dimensions from 256 to 4096 pixels, up to 2,359,296 pixels total. Oversized requests are now rejected instead of silently scaled down; outputs above the native generation limit are upscaled.

Insufficient Pollen and exhausted API key budgets now return HTTP 402, while 403 is reserved for access denied, including model permissions. Enter’s error definitions and API docs clarify the distinction, and Model Monitor reports billing responses separately without counting them against gateway health.

The README’s support section now directs readers to get an API key instead of using donation links. The related funding files and a legacy text-model wrapper that turned errors into donation requests were also removed.
